title: Saro´s Player Ragdoll
description: Players collapse into a realistic physics ragdoll when critically injured — another player can revive them with a First Aid Kit.
body:
---

![header](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Saros_PlayerRagdoll/MP_SarosPlayerRagdoll_header.webp)

![over](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Saros_PlayerRagdoll/MP_SarosPlayerRagdoll_banner1.webp)

Saros Player Ragdoll turns death into a real, physics-driven ragdoll moment. When a player takes lethal damage they collapse into a fully simulated ragdoll instead of just dropping dead — they flop, tumble, slide down stairs and pile up realistically.

**From 1.20.1 the mod is fully standalone** — it ships with its own Bullet physics engine and its own UI, so **no DynamX and no ACsGuis are required**. (Older 1.12.2 builds use the DynamX mod for physics.)

![Features](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Saros_PlayerRagdoll/MP_SarosPlayerRagdoll_banner2.webp)

- **Real ragdoll physics** 🧍
  - On lethal damage you become a fully simulated ragdoll — with knockback coming from the direction you were hit.
  - Ragdolls collide with the terrain, with blocks, and with players, and they settle naturally on stairs, slabs and slopes.
  - Mine the block underneath a ragdoll and it falls; blow it up and it gets flung away (it is not deleted by explosions).

- **Grab & lift** ✋
  - Hold a key (default **V**) and look at a ragdoll to grab a limb and drag it around — the rest of the body follows. Rebindable in the controls.

- **Revive & respawn** ❤️
  - A clean, modern death screen lets you revive or respawn (with a configurable timer).
  - Players can also be revived by right-clicking them while holding the First-Aid Kit.

- **Two physics feels** ⚙️
  - `smooth` (calm, settles naturally) or `floppy` (raw and loose) — switch it in the config.

- **Commands** 💻
  - **/saros_spawn_ragdoll [player]** — drop a ragdoll showing that player's skin at your location.
  - **/saros_spawn_ragdoll death [player]** — put a player into the (invisible) ragdoll/death state.
  - **/saros_spawn_ragdoll kill** — remove all ragdolls.
  - **/revive [player]** — heal and restore a player.
  - **/respawn [player]** — drop items (per config) and respawn.
  - **/instantragdoll <player|all> <on|off>** — toggle ragdoll-on-hit.

<details>
<summary><sub>Legacy — 1.12.2 (DynamX edition)</sub></summary>

<sub>The original 1.12.2 build uses the [DynamX Mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dynamx) for its physics. When you have too few hearts you are automatically placed into DynamX's ragdoll mode, which restricts your movement and actions.</sub>

<sub>**Features:** ragdoll on low health · `/revive [player]`, `/respawn [player]`, `/instantragdoll` (toggle) · revive by right-clicking a downed player (a First-Aid Kit is required from Beta 2.1) · death GUI (from Beta 1.9) · customizable config · a vehicle-damage system where players take speed-scaled damage when hit by DynamX vehicles (configurable min/max).</sub>

</details>
